![](<03ccfe8bb1096e76dd5c186c3ae24d5fe8ec_pg1_images/imageFile1.png>) # Travel & Ground Transportation Information 21st Annual Fall Conference on INTEGRATIVE MEDICINE IN WOMEN’S HEALTH Loews Ventana Canyon Resort Tucson, Arizona ~ September 9-12, 2020 ![](<03ccfe8bb1096e76dd5c186c3ae24d5fe8ec_pg1_images/imageFile2.png>) ![](<03ccfe8bb1096e76dd5c186c3ae24d5fe8ec_pg1_images/imageFile3.png>) ![](<03ccfe8bb1096e76dd5c186c3ae24d5fe8ec_pg1_images/imageFile4.png>) ![](<03ccfe8bb1096e76dd5c186c3ae24d5fe8ec_pg1_images/imageFile5.png>) ![](<03ccfe8bb1096e76dd5c186c3ae24d5fe8ec_pg1_images/imageFile6.png>) #1542 Please see the following information on air and ground transportation. If you haven’t registered for this conference, please go online to www.symposiamedicus.org to register. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us at (925) 969-1789, Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm, (Pacific Time) or email travel-tours@symposiamedicus.org. HOTEL INFORMATION LOEWS VENTANA CANYON RESORT 7000 N. Resort Drive Tucson, Arizona 85750 Phone: (520) 299-2020 AIR TRAVEL INFORMATION The closest airport to the Loews Ventana Canyon Resort is Tucson International Airport (TUS); however, lower fares can sometimes be found by flying into Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX). Tucson is approximately a 40 minute drive to the hotel, while Phoenix is approximately a 2 hour drive. Symposia Medicus has arranged for discount fares with Alaska, Delta, and United Airlines for this conference. To view more information, including airline discount codes, please visit the Conference Registration, Lodging, and Travel Information section of our online brochure at https://bit.ly/38OuBcF GROUND TRANSPORTATION OPTIONS Option #1 – Car Rental We recommend that you rent a car to see the many sites of Tucson and the surrounding area. Symposia Medicus has arranged conference discounts with AVIS and Budget Car Rentals. Reservations can be made online or by phone. Please refer to the conference code and the airport location when making your reservations.
Rental Company Website Phone Number Conference Code
AVIS www.avis.com

 800-331-1600 AWD # B766625
Budget www.budget.com

 800-772-3773 BCD # U076767
## Option #2 – Uber or Lyft - • www.uber.com - • www.lyft.com ## Option #3 – Taxi VIP Taxi and Yellow Cab are under contract with the Tucson Airport Authority (TAA) to meet arriving flights. To reach the cab stand from the main terminal (A and B gates), exit Baggage Claim on the lower level and cross the first roadway to the second roadway where taxis should be to your left. From the C gates, cross the roadway and go east toward the main terminal where you will find the taxis on your left as you near the center of the parking area. If there are no taxis, please use the phone at the cab stand to have one dispatched immediately. Under the contracts with the TAA, taxi rates are set at $5.50 to start and $2.25 per mile with a $12.00 minimum fare. There can also be a charge for traffic delays of up to $22.00 per hour. There are no additional charges for up to three passengers or normal baggage. ## ADDITIONAL TRANSPORTATION OPTIONS For additional transportation options, please contact the concierge at Loews Ventana Canyon Resort at (520) 299-2020. PARKING Self and valet parking are complimentary for conference guests. For driving directions from the Tucson International Airport (TUS), please visit https://goo.gl/maps/JbvRG4rqCaUZuehq9 For driving directions from the Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX), please visit https://goo.gl/maps/V7AbPevBcjsh3d3V8
